name: visa_draft_employer_letter
description: Generate an employment letter template for a France Schengen visa application. Produces a ready-to-print letter for the applicant to take to HR, pre-populated with all required fields: role, salary, approved leave dates, and return-to-work commitment. Also includes a compliance checklist and payslip requirements. For self-employed applicants, the skill guidance covers the alternative self-declaration letter path.

job_title.description: Applicant job title — must match France-Visas form Section 4 exactly

start_date.description: Date the applicant started at this employer (DD Month YYYY)

currency.description: Currency code, e.g. GBP, EUR, USD

contract_type.description: Employment contract type — permanent reads strongest for return commitment

leave_approved.description: Whether leave has been approved for the travel dates

leave_dates.description: Approved leave dates matching travel dates exactly

return_to_work_date.description: First working day back after the trip (DD Month YYYY)

hr_signer_name.description: Name of the person signing the letter

hr_signer_title.description: Title of the signer, e.g. HR Manager, Company Secretary

letter_date.description: Date of the letter (DD Month YYYY); defaults to today
